commercial_assessment.assessment_scope: E-commerce Campaign / 服饰生活方式广告。服饰生活方式广告：强调真人、摄影、材质、氛围与点击动机；不要求价格或促销文案，促销层级与无文字画面的信息可读性可标 NOT_APPLICABLE。

evidence: Garment occupies central vertical axis and ~60% of frame height
High contrast between black outfit and light background ensures visual dominance
No competing foreground objects distract from apparel
product_prominence.summary: Product is clearly the focal point with strong compositional hierarchy.

evidence: Double-breasted vest design and tailored fit are clearly visible
Contrast between structured vest and relaxed shorts communicates styling versatility
Sneaker color blocking highlights design detail but partially obscures brand mark
selling_point_clarity.summary: Key styling features (tailoring, layering) are evident; minor ambiguity in footwear branding.

promotion_hierarchy.summary: No promotional text or graphic elements present; lifestyle ad scope does not require them.

information_legibility.summary: No textual information present; not required for this campaign type.

evidence: Model’s direct gaze and neutral expression invite engagement without distraction
Clean, aspirational setting (minimalist interior) supports desire association
Outfit composition suggests wearable, modern style suitable for daily life
click_motivation.summary: Strong emotional and contextual cues drive curiosity and aspiration without overt call-to-action.

evidence: Vertical full-body framing matches standard e-commerce lifestyle banner ratios
Negative space on right allows for overlay text in live campaigns
Light background ensures compatibility with dark/light UI themes
channel_placement_fit.summary: Composition aligns well with common social feed and homepage placements.

commercial_strengths: Exceptional material fidelity and lighting realism
Clear product focus with balanced styling narrative
High aesthetic coherence supporting brand tone
relative_gaps: Footwear brand mark partially obscured by lacing and angle
No explicit indication of seasonality or occasion use-case
commercial_assessment.summary: High-quality lifestyle image excelling in realism and product prominence; minor opportunity to enhance footwear branding clarity.
